title: Calibrated anonymous markers and separate observed pose joint guide
coordinate_system: Calibrated camera1 common-world XYZ, metres; no floor alignment

display.description: Display only: X right, -Y up, Z depth. Stored XYZ is unchanged.

pose_method.person_selection: Highest IoU >=0.2 against cached person box AND >=3 actual DINO centers within the selected box expanded24nativepx; marker support only identifies the marked subject, never assigns/snaps joint coordinates; missing trusted box skipped; temporal changes recorded, no permanent closure
pose_method.coordinate_system: Exact existing marker calibration common XYZ in metres; no floor/body alignment
pose_method.identity_scope: COCO17 semantic model joints are separate from DINO marker observations; no marker anatomical IDs/snapping/interpolation

interpretation.markers: Actual DINO heatmap centres matched geometrically across calibrated cameras. IDs are anonymous tracks, not anatomical names.
interpretation.joint_guide: Separately inferred 2D pose joints triangulated in the same calibrated coordinates. Cyan edges link only two observed joints.
interpretation.person_selection: DINO centre support is used to select the marked walking person only. Pose joint coordinates come from the pose model and are never snapped to marker centres; the full selection pipeline is not statistically independent.
interpretation.missing: Missing joints and edges stay absent; no interpolation, marker snapping, or inferred anatomical marker IDs.
interpretation.validation: Reprojection agreement measures geometric consistency; anatomical accuracy is not validated.
